## Pre-registered backtest grid

Under the [shared rules of round 1](https://github.com/Acusick1/odds/issues/821).
- t ∈ {0.02, 0.03, 0.04} × decision times ∈ {[1440], [720], [360], [1440, 360]}: 12 cells.
- **Input age:** the draft's `max_input_age_minutes` is 60, matching the backfill's hourly band. A registered version uses 10, with live OddsPortal runs scheduled before these decision times. So the live input is fresher than the backtested one.
- The totals version runs the same grid on half lines, in exchange-gap's totals family.
